improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description under 160 characters improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating what Gideon offers. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical for B2B audiences. The copy highlights key value props (Claude-powered, instant answers, voice chat, free trial) without inventing claims, and includes a clear call to action.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI Trade & Business Partner, Powered by Claude"

Subheading: "Get instant answers to complex trade and business questions. Try Gideon free—no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately establishes Gideon's core value (AI partnership for trade/business) while leveraging Claude's credibility. The subheading addresses the primary user need (instant answers), reduces friction by emphasizing the free trial, and removes the common signup barrier (no credit card). This creates clear value proposition and low-risk entry point for conversion.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's full capabilities—including voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel—the paywall. By clearly explaining what happens next and immediately reinforcing value and affordable pricing, it reduces uncertainty and encourages sign-up rather than abandonment.
